context: Riku and Aoi study together with friends.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (太郎/加藤/あたし/辞書/そういえば) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、太郎と勉強会したよ。
lines.en: Today I had a study session with Taro.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、加藤くんも来たの?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、加藤も辞書を持ってきたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, Kato brought a dictionary too.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あたしの辞書、古いんだよね。
lines.en: My dictionary is old, you know.
lines.style: sheepish barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そういえば、太郎が新しいの勧めてたよ。
lines.en: Come to think of it, Taro recommended a new one.
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へえ、あたしも見てみようかな。
lines.en: Oh, maybe I'll check it out too.
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 加藤が、辞書の使い方も詳しいんだ。
lines.en: Kato's also knowledgeable about using dictionaries.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そういえば、次はあたしも行く!
lines.en: Come to think of it, I'll come next time too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
